name: Step-by-step guide
summary: One step of a procedure that a running block leads: what to do, whether the last action worked (✓/✗), and only the buttons that step takes.
help: For procedures a person does with a machine block guiding them (repairs, calibrations, set-ups). Connect a Telemetry block's stream (from the block that leads) to Data. The block sends its step with ctx.telemetry("guide", {seq, step, text, last, buttons, extra, choices, busy}): seq grows with every item; step is the title; text the instruction (lines starting with 1. or • become a list; a line indented by 4 spaces shows as a command); last the result of the last action, starting with ✓ (green) or ✗ (red); buttons [{label, kind}] the step's buttons (kind send: orange, it sends a command to a device); extra small buttons under the step (Back, Start over, Finish); choices [{name, label, options, value}] drop-downs; busy a text while the block works (buttons off). A press sends {"control": label, "value": true} on the Channel (a choice: {"control": name, "value": option}); the view then says it waits until the next step comes. Facts: live values shown small under the step, one per line as CHANNEL.FIELD=Label.
